items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I used to ask him how was May.

ctx.x: Her father was a waiter down at the Sherman, a little Black and a little Italian. I used to ask him how was May. "She's doing pretty good." She was a barmaid up at one of them popular bars in Chicago on the South Side. There's two guys that had a club; I can't think of their names.
